dispatch.inside: C0 physical candidates UNION selected wall-component candidates; choose ONE circuit by energy/resource
dispatch.reason: Pre-confirmation fixed regional construction: wall innovation targets low-field competition; matched-effort physical greedy elsewhere. Pure C2/C3 ablations retained in development/validation. This prevents costly unhelpful wall searches in far high-field controls; not oracle per-point selection.

8.features: sqrt(multiplicity)*(m_q^2-1/N) for unique conjugate q pairs + Mx; C omitted because Fourier redundant
8.training: Independent-labelled clean development ED only; no noise labels or coordinates in inference

12.features: sqrt(multiplicity)*(m_q^2-1/N) for unique conjugate q pairs + Mx; C omitted because Fourier redundant

8.features: Even total-wall-count histogram, probability of no adjacent walls, Mx
8.measurement: Uses the same Z/X joint counts; no additional settings. SV high-order wall statistics unavailable in the prescribed30/68-setting estimator and never silently projected.
8.training: Clean independently labelled development ED only

12.features: Even total-wall-count histogram, probability of no adjacent walls, Mx
12.measurement: Uses the same Z/X joint counts; no additional settings. SV high-order wall statistics unavailable in the prescribed30/68-setting estimator and never silently projected.

selection: Energy window1e-6 per site then CNOT then energy; no hard symmetry gate; no ED at selection
method_rule: Carry C1 and H6 only. H6 generates C0 plus validation-selected wall candidates within fixed kappa[.4,.6],h<=.35; energy/resource selects one real circuit. Outside, C0 only. All added classical search is charged; no state averaging or ED selector. All component runs and hybrid validation outcomes retained. No confirmation-dependent routing.
state_access_cost: Analytic statevector energy and gradients; no free final projection; D4 inference uses observable features only; D2 full-state comparisons separately costed
